pin_title: 6 Bonfire Night Essentials Under £15 UK Families Love for a Cosy Night Out
pin_title_alt: 3 Snug Buys to Keep You Warm at a Chilly Bonfire Night Display
pin_hook: Blankets, flasks and toasty extras for 5 November
pin_description: Bonfire Night essentials under £15 for a cosy night outdoors: a waterproof fleece picnic blanket, a classic steel flask for hot chocolate, marshmallow toasting forks, glow sticks for the kids and rechargeable hand warmers. Easy ideas for garden bonfires and firework displays in the UK. #ad #bonfirenight #guyfawkesnight #cosynights #ukdeals
intro: Heading out for the fireworks or hosting a garden bonfire? These well-loved basics keep everyone warm, fed and glowing on 5 November, and every one is under £15.

products.name: LIVEHITOP Fleece Picnic Blanket with Waterproof Backing, 200x200cm
products.headline: Sit on damp grass without the soggy bum
products.why: Soft fleece on top with a waterproof backing, so it works as a ground mat or a wrap-around blanket at a chilly display. It folds up small with a carry strap.

products.name: ThermoCafe Stainless Steel 500ml Flask
products.headline: Hot chocolate on tap while you watch the sky
products.why: A no-fuss stainless steel vacuum flask with a cup lid that has been a reliable favourite for years. Fill it with cocoa or soup before you leave the house.

products.name: MalloMe Extendable Marshmallow Toasting Forks Set
products.headline: Toasted marshmallows round the fire pit
products.why: Telescopic forks keep little hands a safe distance from the flames, and they are reusable, unlike wooden skewers. Great for garden fire pits and s'mores.

products.name: Contigo Byron Snapseal Leakproof Travel Mug, 470ml
products.headline: Keeps your tea hot through the whole display
products.why: The snap-seal lid means no spills in a pocket or bag, and it keeps drinks hot for hours. Handy for the walk to the park and back.

products.name: The Glowhouse Premium Glow Sticks Party Pack, 205 Pieces
products.headline: Easy to spot the kids in the crowd
products.why: Bracelets, necklaces and glasses connectors give kids something to play with and make them easier to keep an eye on in the dark. A safe, fun alternative to sparklers.

products.name: Lepwings Rechargeable Hand Warmers, 2 Pack
products.headline: Warm fingers all evening, no disposables
products.why: Two USB-rechargeable pocket warmers with three heat levels, so you can share one. They can also double as a small power bank for a phone in a pinch.
